citations.cites: E-15 exclusion – Flood, surface water, waves, tidal water, or overflow of any body of water
Definition of "Surface water" – water on the surface of the ground, irrespective of its source

facts: Water entered under the front door during a storm with 71 mm of rain in 24 hours, spreading across hall and lounge floors.
Laminate flooring was lifted throughout; estimated loss $6,200.
note: The loss involves surface water from a storm entering the residence, which triggers the E-15 exclusion for flood and surface water [HO-0304_03-24#05]. The term "surface water" is defined as water on the ground surface regardless of source, matching the facts of rainwater ingress [HO-0304_03-24#02].
